_note: Real NASA records the game may show, fetched once on 15 Nov 2026 and shipped as ARCHIVED (never live). Raw responses: assets-cache/data-snapshots/*_2026-11-15.json at the workspace root. 'factcheck' is the row in research/junior-astronaut/factcheck.md; 'resource' is the item on the challenge's Resources tab. 'checked' says whether the value was seen in the saved file ('seen') or worked out from seen readings ('our maths'). Absorbed dose (Gy) only: never set these beside a sievert value. `show: false` keeps a record out of the game's sources card (ui/game_hud.gd show_sources): it is on disk for the submission, but nothing in play is about it.
